items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: "I'm sorry, Chief, I get it, I get it." ... "But Basie ... never gave me a hard time about it."

ctx.x: Well I can imagine that would be like an un-fun position to be in, like he’s playing this intro and you’re going, [gasp] now?

Well later it became a very fun position to be in, because I knew all the intros, and I knew most all the tunes except maybe some of the new ones that we’d just recorded the day before, the week before, we were all still scuffling and learning ourselves. But it was great. I could tell within one or two bars what the tune was going to be. But I’d still get them mixed up every once in a while, for some reason, I’d get the drum breaks on “Shiny Stockings” mixed up in my mind with the drum breaks on “Corner Pocket,”…
never gave me a hard time about it. He’d just look at me or give me a face. “I’m sorry, Chief, I get it, I get it.”
